channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Por que no Peru a política é um caos, mas a economia é estável
item.description: Peru faces deep political chaos, with nine presidents in ten years, extremely close elections, and figures like Keiko Fujimori and Roberto Sánchez tied to polarizing legacies of former leaders. Despite this, the Peruvian economy shows relative stability in Latin America: GDP grew 3.4% in 2025, gross debt is 33% of GDP, and the fiscal deficit is just 1.9%, contrasting with Brazil’s higher debt, deficit, and interest rates. This disconnect between political instability and macroeconomic solidity is explained by autonomous economic institutions, strict fiscal rules, and a history of responsibility, even amid governmental volatility.

item.title: Após reunião com Lula, ANP adia reformas para priorizar subvenção
item.description: The ANP board decided to postpone four regulatory reforms, including the revision of the LPG (cooking gas) framework, to prioritize the implementation of diesel, gasoline, and LPG subsidies amid international market instability caused by the Middle East war. The decision followed a meeting with President Lula, who demanded immediate solutions for the fuel sector and explanations for delays in subsidy payments. The focus is now on price abuse monitoring and mitigating supply risks.

item.title: Lula lança linha de crédito para compra de motos e bicicletas elétricas por entregadores de app; veja regras
item.description: President Lula launched a special credit line for app-based delivery workers to purchase electric motorcycles and bicycles, available from July 13, aiming to decarbonize and renew urban transport fleets. Eligibility requires at least six months of activity and a minimum of 100 completed deliveries, with enrollment through an official digital portal that authorizes data sharing with Caixa and Banco do Brasil. The program includes formal (celetista) workers providing individual passenger or cargo transport services.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia linha de crédito para entregadores de apps
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announces a new credit line under the Move Brasil program targeting app-based delivery workers, offering financing for motorcycles, scooters, and mopeds, backed by the FGO, with up to 48-month terms and manufacturer discounts. The initiative aims to reduce government resistance among young male workers concentrated in the Southeast, a demographic where the administration faces significant opposition.

item.title: Correção: Alfa Inteligência: Lula tem 44% contra 41% de Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: Alfa Inteligência corrected an error in a 2026 election poll: in the stimulated first round, Lula has 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro 31%, not 41% as previously published. In the second round, Lula leads with 44% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 41%. The correction aims to ensure the accuracy of the disclosed data.

item.title: ANP suspende reforma em regras do gás de botijão após reunião com Lula
item.description: The ANP suspended discussions on changes to cooking gas sales regulations following a meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, responding to criticism from the government and major industry players. The move aims to prevent negative impacts on pricing and accessibility of bottled gas for low-income consumers.

item.title: TSE quer contratar inteligência cibernética e põe na lista empresa de Israel alvo da PF
item.description: The TSE is preparing a tender to spend R$648,000 annually (up to R$3.2 million over five years) to hire a company specializing in social media monitoring and digital intelligence to counter cyber threats and disinformation. Among the listed potential suppliers is the Israeli firm Cognyte, whose FirstMile spy software was investigated by the Federal Police in the 'Abin Paralela' case under Bolsonaro, though the company was not indicted. The TSE clarified that referencing companies in technical studies does not imply endorsement, but merely maps available market solutions.

item.title: Enquanto a direita briga e o centro cala, Lula pauta o País com sua versão dos fatos
item.description: The left, led by Lula, has gained narrative dominance on social media due to the fragmentation of the right, which fails to unite effectively to counter it. Although polarization was intense between 2018 and 2022, the electorate is growing weary of conflict, with about a third seeking a pragmatic alternative. This silent segment of voters could become decisive in 2026 if they find a representation that escapes the algorithmic logic favoring confrontation.

item.title: Economista de Zema defende divisão da Petrobras e choque fiscal em tour por entidades empresariais
item.description: Carlos da Costa, economic coordinator of Romeu Zema's (Novo) government program, is touring business entities to advocate for splitting Petrobras and implementing a fiscal shock as part of the pre-candidate's 2026 presidential platform.

item.title: Câmara: Motta pauta PL da 6x1 como item único para destravar plenário
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta has scheduled the workweek reduction bill as the sole item on next week's plenary agenda to unblock stalled votes. The move, based on a constitutional amendment approved in May, proceeds despite the Lula government's opposition to removing sector-specific details. The proposal, labeled a 'fiscal bomb' by the Finance Ministry, carries an estimated R$ 140 billion cost over 13 years and was already passed by the Senate.

item.title: Indicada por Eduardo, Júlia Zanatta se empolga com a ideia de ser vice de Flávio
item.description: Federal Deputy Júlia Zanatta (PL-SC) expressed enthusiasm about the possibility of being Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) running mate in the 2026 presidential race, following public endorsement by Eduardo Bolsonaro. She highlighted the repeal of the tax reform and easing civilian access to firearms as top priorities, aligning with core bolsonarist values. While analysts note her candidacy may not significantly boost electoral prospects, her loyalty and conservative profile are seen as assets to maintain ideological consistency in the ticket.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido de aliados de Lula contra exibição do filme 'Dark Horse' durante eleições
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques rejected a request by Lula's allies to block the screening of 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, during the 2026 elections. The ruling cited lack of standing, as the plaintiffs — federal deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) and lawyers from Grupo Prerrogativas — are not running for the same national office (Presidency) as Flávio Bolsonaro. The film, linked to alleged illicit financing involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, remains authorized for exhibition.

item.title: Caiado defende classificar facções como terroristas e promete usar Forças Armadas na Amazônia
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, a pre-candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidency, advocated classifying criminal factions as terrorist groups, citing a poll showing 73% public support, and pledged to deploy the Armed Forces in the Amazon to combat drug trafficking, claiming the region is fully controlled by groups like the PCC, Comando Vermelho, and foreign criminal organizations.

item.title: Metrópoles é indicado ao Prêmio Gabriel García Márquez de Jornalismo
item.description: The reportage 'A Política da Bala', produced by Metrópoles, was nominated for the 2026 Gabriel García Márquez Journalism Prize as one of the top 10 multimedia works. The investigation reveals that between 2023 and 2024, 85 people were killed by São Paulo's Military Police while unarmed and 47 were shot in the back, suggesting the possible existence of a 'death squad' responsible for over 20% of homicides. The report, produced by Artur Rodrigues and Renan Porto, analyzed occurrence reports, judicial processes, and videos of 246 police-intervention-related deaths.

item.title: A decisão de Nunes Marques sobre pedido de petista contra filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques rejected a petition by federal deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) and lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho to block the screening of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, due to lack of legal standing. The minister stated that the petitioners are not candidates in the same national race as the target of the request — Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), pre-candidate for president in 2026 — since Correia is only running for federal deputy in Minas Gerais and Carvalho did not claim any intention to run in the 2026 elections. Consequently, the case was dismissed without examining its merits.

item.title: Ter ciúmes da mulher é sinal de fraqueza, diz Lula em live
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that jealousy is a sign of weak character and advocated for trust in relationships to combat violence against women. He also reiterated his willingness to run in 2026 to prevent the far-right from returning to power, citing Flávio Bolsonaro as a reference. The live, held with First Lady Janja da Silva, included musical performances and the exchange of symbolic gifts.

item.title: Lula manda recado para Ancelotti: "O Brasil vai para ganhar"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated that the Brazilian national team must 'play to win' in the 2026 World Cup, expressing confidence in the squad and praising the selected players. He sent a message to coach Carlo Ancelotti, quoting João Saldanha from the 1970 World Cup, and emphasized the players’ role as inspiration for poor youth from the peripheries. The remarks were made during a live broadcast with First Lady Janja to celebrate Valentine’s Day, featuring guest appearances by singer Tereza Cristina and Minister Margareth Menezes.

item.title: Camilo Santana diverge de Lula e apoia classificação do PCC e do CV como organizações terroristas
item.description: Senator Camilo Santana (PT-CE) advocated for classifying the PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations, diverging from President Lula’s government, which views the measure as a national sovereignty issue. He stated he had directly expressed this disagreement to Lula and stressed that security should not be politicized, indirectly criticizing Ciro Gomes. Santana also praised the federal government’s security efforts and urged the Senate to vote on the Public Security PEC.

item.title: Nunes Marques cria comissão no TSE para definir como a Justiça Eleitoral vai usar inteligência artificial
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques of the TSE established a permanent commission to define how the Electoral Justice will use artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections, aiming to combat disinformation. The commission will set standards for AI tool procurement and development, share technologies across regional courts, create a national catalog of existing solutions, and collaborate with universities and external experts on a voluntary basis. Approved TSE rules allow AI use in electoral advertising if clearly disclosed and the tool specified, but ban the circulation of AI-generated content 72 hours before and 24 hours after voting, as well as AI-driven candidate recommendations or rankings by platforms.

item.title: No Dia dos Namorados, Janja faz surpresas em live com Lula; saiba quais
item.description: On Valentine's Day, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and First Lady Janja Lula da Silva celebrated with a live stream, featuring surprise musical performances by singer Tereza Cristina and Minister of Culture Margareth Menezes, who sang 'Amor Perfeito' and 'Amor de Índio'. The couple exchanged gifts — Lula gave Janja white Havaianas sandals, and she gave him a pair with the Brazilian flag — and shared loving declarations, recalling their marriage and letters exchanged during Lula's imprisonment. Lula also used the moment to make political statements, affirming he will run again for president to prevent the far right from returning to power.

item.title: Pai do orçamento secreto, Alcolumbre fez discurso, mas na hora H colocou pautas-bombas para votar
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre delivered a fiscally conservative speech warning about the budgetary impact of 'budget-bomb' proposals, yet allowed them to be voted on, contradicting his stance. Columnist Carlos Andreazza notes Alcolumbre, dubbed the 'father of the secret budget,' is responsible for increased spending via parliamentary amendments, and in an election year, such populist measures pass despite fiscal risks. Andreazza also criticizes Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes for pre-announcing his position on social media regarding proposals that will be judicially reviewed, calling it an inappropriate political act.

item.title: Justiça italiana aponta parcialidade de Moraes como motivo para anular extradição de Zambelli
item.description: Italy’s Supreme Court of Cassation annulled the extradition of former Brazilian deputy Carla Zambelli to Brazil, citing alleged bias by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who allegedly acted as both judge and victim in the case. The court found that Moraes had accumulated judicial functions improperly, including issuing Zambelli’s arrest warrant and being the target of a fake arrest warrant planted by a hacker at her behest. Zambelli was convicted for hacking the National Justice Council’s system and illegal firearm possession during the 2022 elections.

item.title: Lula diz que rico não compra celular roubado, mas pobre compra
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that wealthy people do not buy stolen cell phones, but poor people do because of the low price, during the 7th plenary of CDESS in Brasília. He announced that the government will send alerts to 2.5 million cell phones registered as stolen or stolen in the Celular Seguro program, warning that keeping the device may constitute a crime and expose the user to punishment. Lula said he convened a meeting with Justice Minister Wellington César Lima to discuss the measure, which aims to provide security to 200 million Brazilians.

item.title: A postura de Michelle que vem irritando equipe da pré-campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign team is frustrated with former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro's stance, as she claims she will support the PL's presidential bid at the 'right moment' while already publicly backing various state, senatorial, and proportional candidates, leading allies to suspect she is keeping herself as a backup in case Flávio is dropped from the national race—a scenario they insist will not happen. Her delay in formalizing her own Senate candidacy in the Federal District has further fueled internal tensions.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a receber visitas de Flávio, esposa e netas em prisão domiciliar neste sábado
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to receive visits from his son Flávio Bolsonaro, wife, and granddaughters during lunch on Saturday, between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m., under house arrest. The ruling emphasized that family support is crucial for serving the sentence, provided security protocols are followed, including the confiscation of electronic devices.

item.title: Para não ficar sem luz: Brasil terá operação especial contra 'apagões' durante jogos da seleção na Copa do Mundo
item.description: Brazil will launch a special operation coordinated by the ONS to ensure electricity supply during the Brazilian national team's matches at the 2026 World Cup, banning scheduled maintenance on generation and transmission equipment two hours before and after games. The measure aims to prevent blackouts caused by simultaneous consumption spikes, particularly during halftime and after the final whistle, with enhanced real-time monitoring of the grid and weather forecasts.

item.title: Eduardo posta recepção de Flávio em Belém: “Lembrou o pai”
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro shared a video on X showing the reception of his brother Flávio Bolsonaro in Belém, PA, comparing him to their father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, with the phrase 'He reminded me of dad!'. Flávio attended the launch of pre-campaigns for Dr. Daniel Santos for Pará governor and Éder Mauro for Senate, wearing a shirt that read 'The Amazon is ours'.

item.title: A aposta de Fernando Haddad para crescer nas pesquisas em SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT’s pre-candidate, sees rising violence in São Paulo — particularly femicide and police lethality — as an opportunity to challenge Tarcísio de Freitas in the 2026 election. Although violent crimes declined in the first four months of 2026, SSP-SP data show a consolidated rise in gender-based violence, which the Petista campaign aims to exploit via social media to erode the governor’s approval. The first electoral test will be on June 16 with a Real Time Big Data poll.

item.title: Djalminha vê Argentina mais forte do que em 2022 e coloca Brasil fora dos principais favoritos: 'Falta um conjunto'
item.description: Djalminha praised Lionel Scaloni's work with Argentina, stating the team is stronger today than in 2022 due to tactical cohesion and Messi's central role. He noted that while Brazil has tradition and good players, it lacks a cohesive unit, placing the team fifth among favorites for the 2026 World Cup, behind France, Spain, Argentina and possibly Portugal.

item.title: Justiça italiana diz que STF não foi imparcial sobre Zambelli e cita 'dupla função' de Moraes
item.description: Italy's highest court denied the extradition of former deputy Carla Zambelli to Brazil, ruling her case was not judged impartially by the STF. The decision cites the 'dual function' of Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who acted as both judge and interested party, undermining the neutrality of the proceedings.

item.title: Crusoé: Quem decide a eleição
item.description: Expectations of reduced electoral justice intervention in the 2026 presidential election were dashed on Monday, April 8, when the TSE opened another avenue to expand its oversight of voters, citing urgency. The decision by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques revives concerns about judicial influence in the electoral process, contrasting with the relatively restrained approach seen in 2022.

item.title: Itália cita falta de imparcialidade de Moraes em decisão pró-Zambelli
item.description: Italy’s Supreme Court annulled the extradition of former Brazilian deputy Carla Zambelli to Brazil, ruling that Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes acts as 'victim, witness, and judge' in her cases, violating fundamental rights and international treaties. Her defense argues the decision could set a precedent for other cases, including those of Eduardo Bolsonaro and Alexandre Ramagem, currently in the U.S. Zambelli was arrested in Rome in July 2025 and released in May 2026 after being convicted by the STF for hacking the CNJ and armed persecution of a man in 2022.

item.title: Pautas-bomba irritam Planalto e auxiliarem defendem que Lula procure Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula’s allies are urging him to meet directly with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to unblock the government’s priority agenda in Congress, particularly the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale, following the advancement of fiscally impactful ‘bomb’ bills that have irritated the Planalto. Despite Lula’s reluctance, allies believe the meeting should happen before his trip to the G7 in Paris or upon his return, aiming to prevent further surprises and improve interbranch relations. The government is also considering judicializing the approved measures, citing public support from STF Minister Gilmar Mendes and Chamber President Hugo Motta’s refusal to advance the bills.

item.title: Entenda quais tarifas os EUA querem aplicar contra o Brasil
item.description: The U.S. is evaluating two additional tariff proposals on Brazilian goods: 25% for alleged unfair trade practices and 12.5% for insufficient restrictions on imports made with forced labor, potentially totaling 37.5%. The proposals were announced on June 1 and June 2, 2026, with a final decision expected by July 15 from President Donald Trump. President Lula has denounced the tariffs as false justifications and aims to negotiate their withdrawal in person with Trump at the G7 summit in France, while Brazil’s Minister of Development, Industry and Foreign Trade, Márcio Elias Rosa, is set to meet with USTR Chief Jamieson Greer via videoconference on June 12.

item.title: A segurança de Caiado: 51 PMs, quase R$ 800 mil por mês e, em breve, a PF
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, governor of Goiás and pre-candidate for president in 2026, already has a security detail of 51 military police officers costing nearly R$800,000 per month. He states that he will soon receive reinforcement from the Federal Police for his personal security during the campaign, despite not having officially declared his candidacy. The article notes he has been in pre-campaign mode since the beginning of the year.

item.title: A narrativa de que Trump ameaça o Pix não resiste à realidade
item.description: Lula, the PT, and their allies have revived the claim that the Pix payment system is under threat from the United States, linking it to the designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist groups and potential new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods. However, this narrative lacks factual basis, as there is no evidence the U.S. government intends or has the capacity to interfere with Brazil’s instant payment system.

item.title: Tribunal militar não pode rever provas de crime julgado no STF
item.description: The Military Court cannot review evidence of crimes already judged by the Supreme Federal Court, according to opinions from Judiciary and Public Ministry authorities. The column sought their views on whether the STM could revisit evidence of the coup plot to preserve the ranks of some defendants. The authorities' names were withheld.

item.title: ‘Bondades’ de Lula chegam a R$ 215 bi no ano eleitoral: 96% ficam fora do arcabouço fiscal
item.description: In the 2026 election year, the Lula government has launched economic measures totaling R$215 billion (1.6% of GDP), nearly double the additional revenues collected (R$109 billion, 0.8% of GDP). Of this amount, 96% fall outside the fiscal framework, raising concerns about public finance sustainability. The article notes these 'benevolences' aim to stimulate the economy but create substantial fiscal pressure.

item.title: Bolsonaristas da Bahia resistem a entrar em campanha por ACM Neto caso ex-prefeito não peça voto em Flávio
item.description: Members of Bahia's PL resist supporting ACM Neto in the gubernatorial race unless he backs Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential race. A preliminary agreement exists for ACM Neto to support Ronaldo Caiado in the first round, with potential alignment with Flávio Bolsonaro in a possible second-round runoff against Lula. Bahia's right-wing asserts its support is not automatic and requires mutual dialogue, while the PT's Jerônimo Rodrigues seeks re-election in a technical tie according to recent polls.

item.title: Telão na rua, roda de samba e chope a cada gol: bares para assistir aos jogos do Brasil na Copa
item.description: The World Cup begins on June 11 and Brazil debuts on Saturday the 13th against Morocco. Several bars and restaurants in Rio de Janeiro are offering big screens, live music, beer promotions and snacks to watch the matches, including Antiquário do Breganha (Botafogo), Baródromo (Maracanã) and Beco do Rato (Lapa), featuring samba groups, live music sessions and tributes to carnival personalities like Mestre Ciça.

item.title: Equipe, memes e resposta a Flávio: entenda a queda de braço pela estratégia digital na pré-campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula’s 2026 re-election digital strategy is split between Communications Minister Sidônio Palmeira, who promotes national sovereignty and lighter content via Secom, and Nicole Briones and Ricardo Stuckert, who advocate for a more aggressive stance against rivals like Flávio Bolsonaro, particularly highlighting his ties to Daniel Vorcaro. Despite Sidônio’s close access to Lula, he does not control the president’s Instagram account — which has 14.7 million followers and is managed by Briones and Stuckert, who also oversee PT’s social media. The internal conflict centers on whether the campaign should adopt an institutional, conciliatory tone or a confrontational, polarizing one.

item.title: Urias, cinema e distribuição de álbum da Copa: o final de semana em SP
item.description: São Paulo's weekend offers cultural alternatives for those not watching Brazil's first 2026 World Cup match, featuring Urias' album launch at Sesc Pinheiros and Vanessa da Mata as headliner at the WELLNOW Festival, plus free distribution of World Cup albums and stickers, exhibitions, and film showcases. The agenda includes music, art, and football-themed experiences for diverse audiences.

item.title: Pautas-bomba: ameaça de judicialização agrava crise Lula x Alcolumbre
item.description: The Lula government threatens to judicially challenge 'bombshell' bills passed by Congress, including PL 5.122/2023, which allows the use of pre-salt social fund resources to renegotiate rural debts, with a fiscal impact of up to R$140 billion over 13 years. This has intensified tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who proceeded with the vote despite economic team objections. Other approved measures include special retirement for community health agents and salary adjustments for doctors and dentists, collectively potentially impacting the budget by R$2 trillion over 10 years.

item.title: Saiba quem são os pré-candidatos ao governo e ao Senado na Bahia
item.description: In Bahia, four pre-candidates for state governor and five for the federal Senate have been identified for the 2026 elections. During the pre-campaign phase, these names can promote proposals, attend events, and seek political support, although official candidacies will be confirmed at party conventions between June 20 and August 5.

item.title: As reações do PT da Bahia após a menção na delação de Vorcaro
item.description: Bahia PT leaders state that the mention of the party in Daniel Vorcaro's plea deal, concerning the Credcesta program and Banco Master, causes no concern as there is no evidence of party wrongdoing. They argue any alleged payments or contracts with Banco Master would be a surprise to the party and that the reference is politically motivated to harm President Lula, since Bahia is the sole link between the PT and the financial institution.

item.title: Orçamento paralelo: TCU investiga uso de 'dinheiro esquecido' de trabalhadores nos bancos para o Desenrola 2.0
item.description: The TCU is investigating the transfer of R$ 5.7 billion in 'forgotten money' from workers' bank accounts to the Fundo de Garantia de Operações (FGO), used to guarantee Desenrola 2.0, bypassing the federal budget and spending caps. The Desenrola 2.0 provisional measure revoked a legal provision requiring such funds to be directed to the National Treasury as primary budgetary revenue. While the government defends the program as essential for debt renegotiation, auditors challenge its accounting and budgetary treatment during an election year.

item.title: A agenda-bomba do Senado em ano eleitoral - O Assunto #1738
item.description: The Senate approved spending measures that will increase public expenditures by over R$ 2 trillion in ten years, including rural credit lines, salary raises for doctors and dentists, and relaxed retirement rules for health workers. The federal government warns it may challenge the measures in court, with STF Justice Gilmar Mendes suggesting they could be unconstitutional, while the Executive pushes for votes on its own priorities, such as public security and ending the 6x1 work scale. The approvals reflect growing tension between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and President Lula in an election year.

item.title: Os signos dos jogadores da seleção podem ajudar o Brasil a conquistar o Hexa?
item.description: Astrology suggests that Brazil's national team, founded in 1914 under the sign of Cancer, possesses emotional unity and the ability to turn pressure into motivation. Players like Neymar (Aquarius), Vinícius Júnior and Endrick (both Cancer) bring creativity, loyalty, and boldness, while coach Carlo Ancelotti (Gemini) offers strategic flexibility. Planetary transits in 2026 indicate renewal and maturity, pointing to a favorable outlook in the pursuit of a sixth World Cup title.

item.title: Lula anuncia hoje cerca de R$ 4 bilhões em linha de crédito para entregadores
item.description: President Lula announces a subsidized credit line of approximately R$ 4 billion for motorcycle delivery workers, aimed at facilitating the purchase or replacement of motorcycles, including electric models. The financing will be backed by the FGO, with terms up to 48 months and payroll deductions via platform agreements (e.g., iFood), requiring at least six months of activity. The program targets 700,000 to 1.2 million workers who rely on motorcycles for income.

item.title: Copa do Mundo e São João devem reduzir votações no Congresso; veja propostas que podem ser afetadas
item.description: The World Cup and São João festivities are expected to slow legislative activity in Congress during June and July, with virtual sessions and facultative leave during Brazil’s matches. Controversial proposals such as ending the 6x1 work scale, the Security PEC, and reducing the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16 are likely postponed to the second half of the year, compounded by the parliamentary recess (July 18–31) and party conventions in August. The stalled agenda and avoidance of contentious topics in virtual sessions contribute to a sluggish pace in the Chamber of Deputies.
